title: AR-0050 bounded production provider adapter contract

policy.correlation: unique request id and exact request digest
policy.model_identity: provider and model digest are retained

invariants: Each adapter independently enforces its profile and exact AR-0050 revision-5 binding.
Streaming, interruption, and resume retain the exact request correlation and checkpoint digest.
Tool and file policy denials never execute and never fabricate success.
Provider errors are explicit non-success outcomes.
Evidence is redacted and digest-only; raw provider output is never accepted.
limitations: Offline conformance uses a deterministic in-memory fake transport and cannot prove provider availability, authentication, network, model behavior, or live cancellation.
A passing fixture is local qualification only; real provider qualification is separately gated per adapter.

compatibility.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, no trailing newline
